usdRate.note: EUR/MKD 61.51 (the denar is pegged to the euro). Secondary source because nbrm.mk served a bot check; World Bank 2025 average 54.65.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, North Macedonia inflation (State Statistical Office data)
inflation_cpi.note: Annual CPI 2.7% in September 2026 (2.6% in August, 2.3% in July), published 7 October 2026. Secondary source: stat.gov.mk could not be reached. World Bank 2025 average 4.1%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Denar pegged to the euro (ECB 2% target); CPI 2.3-2.7% in mid-2026, 4.1% in 2025 (World Bank)
inflation_projection.note: The National Bank keeps the denar stable against the euro, so long-run inflation should be close to the euro area's plus a catch-up margin; 3% is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, North Macedonia interest rate (National Bank CB bills rate)
policy_rate.note: Raised 25 bp to 4.25% in June 2026 and held in July and September 2026. Secondary source: nbrm.mk served a bot check.

savings_account_rate.note: No current rate for ordinary denar savings or sight deposits could be read: the National Bank's interest-rate statistics (nbrm.mk) served a bot check.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No 3-month denar term deposit rate could be read: the National Bank's interest-rate statistics (nbrm.mk) served a bot check.

fdr_1y_rate.note: The researcher's figure (2.62% for June 2026 from TheGlobalEconomy.com, quoting National Bank data) could not be re-confirmed: that page returned HTTP 429 on every retry and nbrm.mk returned 403. The World Bank average deposit rate was 2.72% in 2025 (bank_deposit_avg_rate).

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found; the National Bank's statistics could not be read.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Deposit interest rate 2.72% for 2025 (National Bank data via IMF).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: biznis.rs news report on the third citizen bond (gradjanska obveznica) issue of North Macedonia
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: 2-year denar citizen bond sold to individuals through banks (auction 12 Dec 2025, matures 19 Dec 2027), 4.5% annual coupon, minimum MKD 10,000; the second issue (Nov 2023) paid 5%. No 5-year retail bond exists.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No current 3-month treasury bill yield was found: recent Ministry of Finance auctions reported in the news are 1-year bills, and the National Bank's auction pages served a bot check.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No current 5-year government bond yield could be read (National Bank auction pages blocked, no market quote on Trading Economics).

tbond_10y_rate.note: No current 10-year government bond yield could be read (National Bank auction pages blocked, no market quote on Trading Economics).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, North Macedonia income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest on time savings is in principle taxed at 10%, but taxation is postponed until EU accession; interest on call deposits is exempt.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, North Macedonia income determination
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Interest on bonds issued by the state and local government units and on public loans is exempt.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: The Deposit Insurance Fund's site (fod.gov.mk) and the National Bank's site could not be reached; older reports give EUR 30,000 per depositor per bank (2019), but the current limit could not be confirmed.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: The consumer credit law caps the annual cost at five times the statutory penalty interest rate (2019 amendment, reported secondarily), but the current reference rate on nbrm.mk could not be read.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Denar pegged to the euro; World Bank exchange rate PA.NUS.FCRF
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund in denar terms if world shares are weak; the local exchange (MBI10) is small and illiquid.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.72% in 2025 (World Bank FR.INR.DPST, tax-free) plus a 3.3-point equity premium
equity_return_base.note: North Macedonia's stock market is thin, so the base is a diversified global or regional index in denar terms (pegged to the euro), kept within 4 points of the tax-free deposit rate.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Long-run global equity returns; denar pegged to the euro
equity_return_high.note: High case near long-run global equity returns with a stable denar-euro peg.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank official exchange rate (denar per USD)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price and a stronger euro (and denar).

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank official exchange rate (denar per USD); long-run dollar gold trend
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5%, with the denar following the euro and no expected trend against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank official exchange rate (denar per USD)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and a weaker euro and denar.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.72% in 2025 (World Bank), falling in 2026
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: a mix of sight and short term deposits as rates drift lower.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.72% in 2025 (World Bank FR.INR.DPST); interest on deposits currently untaxed
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: rolling denar term deposits at about the 2025 average deposit rate, untaxed while the 10% tax on savings interest is postponed.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: buying government citizen bonds and longer deposits when offered.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Insurance Supervision Agency (ASO) publishes market reports, but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold, mostly with bank loans, but no regulator or official premium table per MKD 1,000 of cover by age was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No official figure for the typical out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found; public hospital care under the Health Insurance Fund carries co-payments.

health_premium_table.note: Voluntary private health insurance is small and no published premium table per MKD 100,000 of cover by age was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Health CPI +1.3% year on year in September 2026 (Trading Economics, State Statistical Office data)
goal_inflation_health.note: Measured health prices are rising slowly, but with about 40% of health spending paid out of pocket we plan with the 3% projection plus one point.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Education CPI +5.4% year on year in September 2026 (Trading Economics, State Statistical Office data)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices are rising about 5% a year, which is used for planning.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN WPP 2024 medium variant via populationpyramid.net (mortality, 2026)
life_expectancy.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 for 2026: men 75.6, women 80.0; same source as life_table_remaining. World Bank 2024 estimate 76.6 (men 74.5, women 78.9).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN WPP 2024 medium variant via populationpyramid.net (mortality, 2026)
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 for 2026, five-year age groups; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: UN WPP 2024 medium variant via populationpyramid.net (old-age dependency ratio)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 29.3 (2026), 38.6 (2040) and 56.4 (2065, populationpyramid.net/tfyr-macedonia/2065/). World Bank 2025: 28.5.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Wikipedia, Retirement age (country table, North Macedonia 2026)
retirement_age_default.note: Men 64, women 62, with at least 15 years of pension service; secondary source because the Pension and Disability Insurance Fund (piom.com.mk) site could not be reached. No legislated increase for later cohorts was found.

retirement_age_government.note: No separate retirement age for public employees could be confirmed from a readable official source; public servants are generally covered by the same pension insurance (men 64, women 62).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.72% in 2025 (World Bank), falling in 2026
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly sight and short deposits.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.72% in 2025 (World Bank FR.INR.DPST), interest tax-free
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept just below the tax-free average deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a mix of citizen bonds and term deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.72% in 2025 (World Bank); global equity in denar terms
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Average deposit rate 2.72% in 2025 (World Bank); equity base 6%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half global equity at 6% and half deposits and citizen bonds at about 3%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Law on Social Security for the Elderly (Gazette 104/2019), art. 6: MKD 6,000 a month, raised each January by the previous year's cost-of-living increase (plus MKD 1,000 a month for energy from October to March, art. 7); the 2026 amount could not be found on a readable official page.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Law on Social Security for the Elderly (Official Gazette 104/2019), Ministry of Social Policy, Demography and Youth
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Law on Social Security for the Elderly (Gazette 104/2019), arts. 3-4: from age 65 for citizens with permanent residence for the last 15 years, no property to live from, no domestic or foreign pension and no income in the last 3 months (conditions also apply to the spouse); only one member of a couple can claim. The law text is from 2019 (older than 2025); later amendments were not re-checked.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Relations Law provides a one-off payment on retirement rather than a days-per-year gratuity, but its current text could not be read from an official source, so no figure is given.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Assembly bill amending the Law on Pension and Disability Insurance (March 2026), citing Gazette 154/2025
public_pension_scheme.sourceUrl: https://www.mchamber.mk/Upload/Documents/Предлог на закон за изменување и дополнување на Законот за пензиското и инвалидското осигурување, по скратена постапка.pdf
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory pay-as-you-go pension (Pension and Disability Insurance Fund), plus a mandatory funded second pillar for younger workers. The cited March 2026 bill shows pensions adjusted on 1 September 2025 and 1 March 2026 using 50% of CPI growth and 50% of average wage growth (Gazette 154/25, replacing art. 37 for that period) and proposes a flat MKD 1,000 increase from 1 March 2026. The pension age (64 men, 62 women with 15 years of service) is not in this bill; it comes from the retirement_age_default source.

dps.note: No standard fixed-rate recurring deposit product with a published rate was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: 2-year denar bonds sold to individuals through banks in occasional issues (2023, 2025); interest tax-exempt.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by the Ministry of Finance through the National Bank; recent issues are mostly 1-year bills.

equity_fund.note: Open-end investment funds are supervised by the Securities and Exchange Commission.

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold found.

centralBank.name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia

insuranceComplaints.name: Insurance Supervision Agency (ASO), consumer complaints
insuranceComplaints.note: The agency handles complaints against insurers.

pensionScheme.name: Pension and Disability Insurance Fund of North Macedonia (FPIOM)

oldAgeAllowance.name: Social security for the elderly (Ministry of Social Policy, Demography and Youth)

publicHealthCover.name: Health Insurance Fund of North Macedonia (FZOM)
